chunks.arabic_text: وَسَأَلَ جَابِرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْجُعْفِيُّ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنِ السَّامِّ أَبْرَصَ يَقَعُ فِي الْبِئْرِ

translations.en: Jābir ibn Yazīd al-Juʿfī asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a gecko falling into a well.

chunks.arabic_text: فَقَالَ لَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ حَرِّكِ الْمَاءَ بِالدَّلْوِ

translations.en: So he said: “It is of no consequence; stir the water with the bucket.”

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a gecko falling into a well. Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام states that it does not render the water problematic and instructs that the water be stirred with a bucket.
en.seo_question: What is the ruling if a gecko falls into a well?

key_terms.السَّامِّ أَبْرَصَ: a gecko, the animal asked about in the ruling
key_terms.الْبِئْرِ: the well into which the animal fell
key_terms.لَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ: it is of no consequence; it does not cause concern here
key_terms.الْمَاءَ: the water that is the subject of the ruling
key_terms.بِالدَّلْوِ: with the bucket, the instructed means of stirring
